notes.title: Update 0.1.0a
notes.content: [p]A quick update before playtesting.[/p][p][/p][h2][b][u]Additions[/u][/b][/h2][p]-An option to fade out the HUD when not in use has been added to the options menu.[/p][p]-You can now set the time limit when creating a custom game.[/p][p][/p][h2][b][u]Changes[/u][/b][/h2][p]-Graffiti Can now leaves paint streaks on designated graffiti spots.[/p][p]-Camcorder has been reworked to have more consistency when gathering footage.[/p][p][/p][h2][b][u]Fixes[/u][/b][/h2][p]-Fixed various networking issues[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45592226/cf05e960c27174eb57f0137e0130817f170b787e.png"][/img][/p]
